items.reason: Describes the swapped fabricator file contents. The additional duplicate-definition claim does not change the shared problem or fix.
Describes comparing lower(host) against a parsed hostname that has not been lowercased, rejecting mixed-case hosts.
Describes unchecked nil lookup results in update and destroy causing 500 errors for unknown IDs.
Describes unchecked empty migration query results causing a crash when embed_category is absent. This broader comment also includes the SQL interpolation problem in issue #06.
Describes the same missing lowercase normalization of the parsed host before comparison with lower(host).
Describes mixed-case hosts being rejected because only the database side of the comparison is lowercased.
Describes the category and embeddable-host fabricator files having their contents swapped.
Describes the misleading blank-host spec, which passes because the topic lacks an embed rather than testing host availability.
Describes the blank-host spec lacking the prerequisites needed to isolate host availability, allowing it to pass regardless of host state.
Describes the normalization callback calling sub! on a nil host and raising instead of returning validation errors.
Describes update and destroy dereferencing nil lookup results for nonexistent host IDs.
Describes the migration indexing missing category-query rows before checking whether they exist, causing migration failure.
Describes the same unguarded first-row access that crashes the migration when embed_category is not stored.
